formula: X rose steadily, while Y declined
note: Для двох ліній, що рухаються у протилежних напрямках.
example: Online sales rose steadily throughout the period, while high-street sales declined.

exercises.practice: Internet use kept going up between 2000 and 2020, but newspaper reading kept going down.
exercises.answer: Internet use rose steadily between 2000 and 2020, while newspaper readership declined.
exercises.answerNote: "kept going up / down" — розмовно; замінили на "rose steadily" / "declined".

exercises.practice: The number of cinema visits went up gradually over the decade, but DVD rentals went down.
exercises.answer: The number of cinema visits rose steadily over the decade, while DVD rentals declined.
exercises.answerNote: "went up gradually" = "rose steadily" — синоніми, обирай залежно від контексту.

exercises.practice: Public library visits went up little by little each year, while bookshop visits kept falling.
exercises.answer: Public library visits rose steadily each year, while bookshop visits declined.
exercises.answerNote: "little by little" передає той самий сенс, що й "steadily".

formula: The gap between X and Y widened / narrowed over the period
note: Показує, як змінювалась РІЗНИЦЯ між двома лініями з часом.
example: The gap between male and female wages narrowed slightly over the decade.

exercises.practice: At first men and women earned very different amounts, but by the end the difference was much smaller.
exercises.answer: The gap between male and female earnings narrowed considerably over the period.
exercises.answerNote: Довге пояснення "at first...by the end" стиснули в одну чітку структуру про сам ГЕП.

exercises.practice: In 2000 city and rural incomes were close, but by 2020 the difference had grown much bigger.
exercises.answer: The gap between city and rural incomes widened considerably between 2000 and 2020.

exercises.practice: The difference between imports and exports got smaller and smaller across the period shown.
exercises.answer: The gap between imports and exports narrowed steadily over the period shown.

note: Для моменту, коли одна лінія перетинає й обганяє іншу.
example: Solar energy overtook coal as the main power source in 2019.

exercises.practice: In 2015, electric car sales became higher than sales of diesel cars for the first time.
exercises.answer: Electric car sales overtook diesel car sales for the first time in 2015.
exercises.answerNote: "became higher than... for the first time" → одне дієслово overtook.

exercises.practice: In 2018, spending on streaming became higher than spending on cable TV for the first time.
exercises.answer: Spending on streaming overtook spending on cable TV for the first time in 2018.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама конструкція — тема інша, формула та сама.

exercises.practice: China's exports became bigger than the USA's exports in 2007.
exercises.answer: China's exports surpassed those of the USA in 2007.
exercises.answerNote: "those of the USA" = "the USA's exports", множина → those, не that.

formula: X remained relatively stable, whereas Y fluctuated considerably
note: Одна лінія рівна, друга — постійно вгору-вниз.
example: Birth rates remained relatively stable, whereas immigration figures fluctuated considerably.

exercises.practice: Rainfall in the north didn't change much year to year, but in the south it went up and down a lot.
exercises.answer: Rainfall in the north remained relatively stable, whereas figures in the south fluctuated considerably.
exercises.answerNote: "went up and down a lot" → академічне fluctuated considerably.

exercises.practice: Prices for bread didn't really change over the five years, but prices for petrol went up and down a lot.
exercises.answer: Prices for bread remained relatively stable over the five years, whereas petrol prices fluctuated considerably.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама пара дієслів працює для будь-яких двох ліній графіка.

exercises.practice: Employment in agriculture stayed about the same, but employment in tech kept changing a lot year to year.
exercises.answer: Employment in agriculture remained relatively stable, whereas employment in tech fluctuated considerably.

formula: The rate of increase in X far outpaced that of Y
note: Порівнюємо не самі числа, а ШВИДКІСТЬ зростання.
example: The rate of increase in smartphone ownership far outpaced that of desktop computers.

exercises.practice: Streaming subscriptions grew a lot faster than cinema ticket sales over the same period.
exercises.answer: The rate of growth in streaming subscriptions far outpaced that of cinema ticket sales.
exercises.answerNote: "grew a lot faster than" → формальна структура зі словом rate, "that of" замінює повторення.

exercises.practice: Online grocery shopping grew a lot faster than in-store grocery shopping over the same five years.
exercises.answer: The rate of growth in online grocery shopping far outpaced that of in-store shopping over the same five years.
exercises.answerNote: Ця формула завжди про ШВИДКІСТЬ, а не про самі кінцеві цифри.

exercises.practice: Wind power capacity increased a lot quicker than nuclear power capacity between 2005 and 2020.
exercises.answer: The rate of increase in wind power capacity far outpaced that of nuclear power between 2005 and 2020.
exercises.answerNote: "increased a lot quicker than" → "the rate of increase in... far outpaced that of".

formula: X grew at a much faster rate than Y
note: Простіша альтернатива попередній формулі — теж про швидкість зростання.
example: The population of the suburbs grew at a much faster rate than that of the city centre.

exercises.practice: The number of app users increased a lot quicker than the number of website visitors.
exercises.answer: The number of app users grew at a much faster rate than that of website visitors.
exercises.answerNote: "increased a lot quicker than" → grew at a much faster rate than.

exercises.practice: The population of the coastal region increased a lot quicker than the population of the inland region.
exercises.answer: The population of the coastal region grew at a much faster rate than that of the inland region.
exercises.answerNote: Знову "that of" замінює повторення "the population of".

exercises.practice: Membership at the new gym rose a lot faster than membership at the older branch.
exercises.answer: Membership at the new gym grew at a much faster rate than that at the older branch.
exercises.answerNote: "that at" — бо далі йде місце (the older branch), а не інший іменник.
